<b>剧情</b>：20世纪70年代初的北京，忙着“闹革命”大人无空理会小孩，加上学校停课无事可做，以军队大院男孩为突出代表的少年人便自找乐子，靠起哄、打架、闹事、拍婆子等方式挥霍过量的荷尔蒙。马小军（夏雨 饰）就是这样的少年，他的嗜好之一是趁别人家无人用万能钥匙将其锁打开，溜进去耍玩一番，正是用这样的方式，少女米兰（宁静 饰）的照片先于其人入了马小军的双眼。通过院里的“头儿”刘忆苦（耿乐 饰），马小军又见到之前在炮局偶然瞥见过一眼的米兰，开始正式将其当作梦中情人，然而在米兰眼中，马小军不过是毛孩一个，她中意的人是成熟、稳重、帅气的刘忆苦。自此，马小军迎来五味混杂的青春期生活。 本片改编自王朔短篇小说《动物凶猛》。夏雨凭此片获得第51届威尼斯国际电影节最佳男演员（银狮奖）。<br>
</div>

<script>
$(document).on("click", ".talk, .talkf", function () {
var button = $(this);
var isForumTalk = button.hasClass("talkf");
var send = {
content: button.parent().parent().find("textarea").val(),
u_id: button.attr("u_ID"),

};

}

$.ajax({
type: "GET",
url: isForumTalk ? "/api/forum/forumTalkPost" : "/api/forum/talkPost",
cache: true,
dataType: "json",
data: send,
beforeSend: function () {

button.text("提交");
button.removeAttr("disabled");
}
},
error: function () {

button.text("提交");

}
});
});

(function () {
if (window.bootstrap && bootstrap.Tooltip) {

(function () {
function pad(value) {
return value < 10 ? "0" + value : String(value);
}

function sameDay(a, b) {
return a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() &&
a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() &&
a.getDate() === b.getDate();
}

function sameYear(a, b) {
return a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear();
}

function clock(date) {
return pad(date.getHours()) + ":" + pad(date.getMinutes());
}

function monthDayClock(date) {
return pad(date.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(date.getDate()) + " " + clock(date);
}

function fullDate(date) {
return date.getFullYear() + "-" + pad(date.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(date.getDate());
}

function formatLocalTime(date) {
var now = new Date();
if (sameDay(date, now)) return clock(date);
if (sameYear(date, now)) return monthDayClock(date);
return fullDate(date);
}

var nodes = document.querySelectorAll("time[data-local-time]");
for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i += 1) {
var node = nodes[i];
var value = node.getAttribute("datetime");
if (!value) continue;
var date = new Date(value);
if (isNaN(date.getTime())) continue;
node.textContent = formatLocalTime(date);
}
})();

window.addEventListener("load", function () {
window.setTimeout(function () {
var loadTime = 0;
if (window.performance && typeof window.performance.getEntriesByType === "function") {
var navigation = window.performance.getEntriesByType("navigation")[0];
if (navigation && navigation.duration) loadTime = navigation.duration;
}
if (!loadTime && window.performance && window.performance.timing) {
var timing = window.performance.timing;
if (timing.loadEventEnd && timing.navigationStart) {
loadTime = timing.loadEventEnd - timing.navigationStart;
}
}
var target = document.getElementById("page-load-time");
if (target && loadTime > 0) {
target.innerHTML = "| 加载 " + (loadTime / 1000).toFixed(2) + "s";
}
}, 0);
});
</script>
